target_customer: Marketing and growth teams at software companies running in-product campaigns
problem: Teams struggle to promote features and upsells inside their own products and to refresh campaign content that performs, without engineering work.
business_model: B2B SaaS for in-product marketing (house ad server and content bank)
product_category: Marketing content personalization and in-product house ads

founders.name: Jonathan Ou
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a similar platform at Dropbox that reached 100 million dollars ARR (the Dropbox tool, not Resonance) and a voice ordering AI at DoorDash; one aggregator gives a Microsoft Teams background instead.

technical_complexity.rationale: A no-code campaign builder, targeting and frequency management is conventional web software; personalization with generative models added moderate difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded in a customer's product and campaign data, but adoption platforms like Pendo and Appcues already offered in-app messaging.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Acquirer and date are not public in sources found.

market_need_then: In-app messaging for cross-sell and upsell was an established practice with vendor tooling, but no sourced demand evidence for a dedicated house ad server was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses useresonance.com (prefix), so the plain name domain was not used; the site now returns 404.

brand_strength.rationale: Search results are dominated by unrelated Resonance companies and a marketing concept of the same name; no press about this brand.

pivots.from: in-product ad server for house ads
pivots.to: self-improving content bank for marketing campaigns
pivots.why: Not stated; an older YC launch post and the current description differ.

outcome_analysis: Resonance was a one founder, two person Winter 2024 company whose pitch shifted from an in-product house ad server to a self-improving marketing content bank. Only a roughly 500K dollar YC amount appears on aggregators, the website now returns 404, and YC lists it as acquired with no named buyer, date or terms. With no public account of the deal, the cause and quality of the outcome cannot be judged.
notes: Website useresonance.com returned 404 on fetch. About 500K dollars from YC (CB Insights says a convertible note January 2024, VCBacked says pre-seed April 2024) is aggregator only and unverified, so no round is recorded. No acquirer found in two searches. The competitor search returned only generic Pendo and Appcues comparisons undated near the batch, so the list is empty. Founder bio conflicts between YC and CB Insights.
